question: Which state was crowned the team champion at the 4th National Finswimming Championship, 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• West Bengal was crowned as the team champion at the 4th National Finswimming Championship held in 2024.
 
• The event showcased remarkable performances by athletes from various states, but West Bengal emerged as the dominant team.
 
• Finswimming is a competitive sport that involves swimming with the use of fins, and it requires a combination of speed, strength, and technique.
 
• The championship saw participation from top finswimmers across the country, making it a highly competitive event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Finswimming**

 
 
• Finswimming is an underwater sport consisting of four techniques using either monofins or bifins.
 
• It is governed by the Confédération Mondiale des Activités Subaquatiques (CMAS).
 
• Competitions can be held in swimming pools or open water, with various distances ranging from sprints to long-distance events.
 
 
 
• **National Finswimming Championship**
 
 
• The National Finswimming Championship is an annual event that brings together the best finswimmers from across India.
 
• The championship aims to promote the sport and identify talent at the national level.
 
• It serves as a platform for athletes to qualify for international competitions.
 
 
 
• **Training and Preparation**
 
 
• Finswimmers undergo rigorous training that includes strength conditioning, technique refinement, and endurance building.
 
• Advanced equipment such as specialized fins and snorkels are used to enhance performance.
 
• Coaches play a crucial role in developing strategies and ensuring athletes meet their peak performance.
